meta.title: Atlas - Supervised AI workflows for business
meta.description: Turn repetitive work into AI workflows you can copy, test, approve, and cost-track.

home.eyebrow: AI workflows with humans in control
home.title: Repetitive work runs itself. Important decisions stay with you.
home.lead: Pick a template, add your business context, and let AI agents score, draft, and log. Every outbound action waits for approval, and every step is recorded with its cost.
home.canvasCaption: Synthetic sample run: Inbound Lead Qualification
home.stepsTitle: From blank to running in four steps
home.step1d: Start from a tested workflow instead of a blank canvas.
home.step2d: Score thresholds, channels, and approval policies are configured without code.
home.step3d: Run a test and inspect every step before it touches a customer.
home.step4d: See execution traces, the approval queue, and AI cost per run.
home.controlTitle: Humans approve, AI does the work
home.controlBody: Customer messages, data changes, and other outbound actions stop in the approval queue. Drafts are visible, reasons are recorded, and approvals expire.
home.costBody: Every model call records model, tokens, latency, and estimated cost. A monthly workspace budget halts runs before a new model call once the limit is reached.
home.traceBody: Events are recorded in order and never edited. You can see what happened, when, and why.
home.catalogTitle: Templates for work that actually repeats
home.finalTitle: Start with one workflow that works well.
home.finalBody: Create a workspace, install a template, and run a test with synthetic data in minutes.
home.honesty: Atlas is an MVP. Integrations currently run in simulation mode; no messages are actually sent externally.

templates.title: Template catalog
templates.lead: Each template is a versioned workflow definition. Install, test, then customize without changing code.
templates.empty: No matching templates. Try another keyword.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.lead: Final pricing is not set during the MVP. The structure below is a plan and may change.
pricing.sprintBody: One clearly scoped workflow, built with our team until it runs.
pricing.auditBody: A paid diagnostic to find your highest-value workflow.
pricing.careBody: Monitoring, prompt tuning, and fixes once a workflow is live.
pricing.aiNote: AI model cost: during the MVP, AI credits are platform-funded and metered per workspace. Bring-your-own-key (BYOK) is planned.

security.title: Security & trust
security.lead: What is actually implemented in this MVP, with no certification claims.
security.i1d: Every data query filters by the workspace from a signed session, never from browser input.
security.i2d: Passwords are never stored in plain text.
security.i3d: Template validation rejects external actions without an approval step.
security.i4d: Every side effect has a unique key so retries never duplicate actions.
security.i5d: FULL, REDACTED, or MINIMAL controls how much input content is kept in execution traces.
security.i6t: API keys stay on the server
security.i6d: AI provider credentials are read from server environment variables and never sent to the browser.
security.contact: Report security issues to the team via the contact page.
